page.layout: Running head at top centre, page number at top left; one column of running text; three marginal references in the left margin, beside the lines "cùm solenne" to "Epistolam"; no text below the column.

main_text.p: tionem magnificè aperteque disseruisse, quod cùm in istis quos tractamus Commentarijs non appareat, hinc consequitur Opus esse à decem illis Tomis diversum; Huic objectioni se satis fecisse putat clarissimus Huetius, si omnem culpam rejiciat in Rufinum Interpretem, cui, inquit, cùm solenne sit pervertere omnia, & ad libitum recoquere, adeò ut Tomos Origenis in Epistolam ad Romanos ad mediam partem coarctaverit, quis ullam ab eo fidem expectet? Fateor Rufinum pleráque quæ vertebat opuscula immutare ac interpolare solitum esse, sed propterea verisimile non est Rufinum, istum ut ita dicam peculiarem Origenis characterem, afferre videlicet & differere varias Interpretum Græcorum Editiones, à legitimo Origeniano opusculo auferre voluisse, imprimis post Hieronymi admonitionem; præterea non liquidò constat Rufinum hujus Operis Interpretem esse, nec tanti mihi videntur doctissimi ad id probandum Huetij rationes, ut nos in assensum trahant; Hieronymus, ait, non fuit Commentariorum istorum Interpres, esto, ergo Rufino adscribenda est hæc interpretatio, negatur consequentia; sed Gennadius, inquit, in Catalogo Virorum illustrium significare videtur, quæcunque Origenis opera Hie-Origen. lib. 3. pag. 249

page.notes: The left margin note reads "Origen. / lib. 3. / pag. 249" on three lines; transcribed as one note. The page number "96" at top left is set in a decorative form and may be read as 96 with some uncertainty. Italic extent in the body is judged from the scan and may be imprecise. The "Digitized by Google" watermark at bottom right is omitted.
